definitions.gloss: level of happiness; degree of happiness; happiness index
definitions.explanation: A measure or degree of how happy someone is, or how happy the people of a country or region are. Often used in surveys, rankings, and research on well-being.

examples.japanese: {幸福度|こうふくど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To rank high in the happiness index.

examples.japanese: フィンランド⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{幸福度|こうふくど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上位|じょうい}→上位：11188_joui⟧だ。
examples.english: Finland is always at the top of the world happiness rankings.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{幸福度|こうふくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is research showing that happiness levels are not determined by money alone.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧ (happiness) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree/level). A widely used term in discussions of well-being, social policy, and international comparisons.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in news articles about the ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{幸福度|こうふくど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧ (World Happiness Report) and in discussions of work-life balance, social welfare, and quality of life.
The suffix ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ is productive for creating 'degree of' compounds: {満足度|まんぞくど} (satisfaction level), {認知度|にんちど} (recognition level), {達成度|たっせいど} (achievement level).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幸福度|こうふくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: happiness level is high
- {幸福度|こうふくど}⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧: happiness ranking
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{幸福度|こうふくど}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: world happiness survey
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧{幸福度|こうふくど}: national happiness level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {満足度|まんぞくど}: satisfaction level — focuses on contentment with a specific thing
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}の{質|しつ}→生活の質：17482_seikatsunoshitsu⟧: quality of life — broader concept of living standards
- ⟦{幸福感|こうふくかん}→幸福感：16270_koufukukan⟧: sense of happiness — the subjective feeling rather than a measured index
